title: Task Management Application
shortDescription: Full-stack task management platform with real-time tracking, role-based access control, and interactive productivity dashboards.
fullDescription: A comprehensive full-stack task management platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Enables real-time task tracking and team collaboration. Features role-based access control (RBAC) for multi-user workflows and interactive dashboards powered by Chart.js for visualizing team productivity, task completion rates, and workload distribution.
features: Real-time task tracking and team collaboration
Role-based access control (RBAC) for multi-user workflows
Secure REST APIs with JWT authentication
Task completion rate and workload distribution analytics
challenges: Designing a flexible RBAC system that scales across multiple team structures
Building performant real-time dashboards with complex aggregations

title: Dynamic Portfolio
shortDescription: A fully dynamic developer portfolio where all content is driven from JSON data files — no hardcoding required.
fullDescription: A modern, fully dynamic portfolio website where all profile, experience, skills, and project data is loaded from JSON configuration files. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Features dark/light theme switching, smooth Framer Motion animations, responsive layouts, and a clean project showcase with filtering. Deployed on Netlify.
features: All data driven from JSON — zero hardcoded content
Framer Motion page and component animations
challenges: Building a fully data-driven architecture with TypeScript type safety
Implementing a robust dark/light theme system with CSS variables

title: Heavy Vehicle Management System
shortDescription: Full-stack logistics platform with real-time vehicle tracking, load request management, route optimization, and a mobile app for drivers.
fullDescription: A complete logistics management platform designed for tracking heavy vehicles in real time. Built with Angular for the web dashboard and Angular Native for mobile, enabling drivers and managers to access tracking and logistics features on the go. The FastAPI backend with MySQL handles transactional data efficiently, while third-party GPS APIs power live location updates.
features: Real-time vehicle tracking via GPS APIs
Load request management and route optimization
Mobile application for drivers and managers
challenges: Integrating third-party GPS APIs for reliable real-time tracking
Building a performant mobile app with Angular Native

title: Data Analytics & Visualization Platform
shortDescription: Full-stack analytics platform with interactive public dashboards, real-time charts, custom filters, and automated CI/CD deployment.
fullDescription: A comprehensive data analytics and visualization platform built with Angular and FastAPI. Features an interactive public dashboard with real-time charts built using ApexCharts, Chart.js, and ECharts. Organizations can securely input data which is instantly reflected on the public visualization dashboard. Deployed on Apache with automated CI/CD pipelines.
features: Interactive public dashboard with real-time charts
Custom filters and data export capabilities
Secure organizational data input with live visualization
Multiple chart libraries: ApexCharts, Chart.js, ECharts
challenges: Ensuring real-time data sync between input forms and public dashboards
Setting up zero-downtime CI/CD deployments on Apache

title: Full-Stack Blog Platform
shortDescription: Complete blogging platform with a React/JavaScript frontend and Node.js/Express backend, deployed on Vercel.
fullDescription: A full-stack blogging application split into a dedicated frontend and backend. The backend (blogging-backend) is a RESTful API built with Node.js and Express, deployed on Vercel. The frontend (blog-frontend) is a JavaScript React app with full CRUD capabilities for blog posts, user authentication, and a clean reading experience.
features: Deployed on Vercel for both frontend and backend
challenges: Structuring a clean separation between frontend and backend repos
Handling auth tokens securely across deployed services

title: Chat App — Real-Time Collaboration
shortDescription: Real-time chat application for team collaboration built with JavaScript and WebSocket technology.
fullDescription: A real-time chat application built for team collaboration. Supports live messaging, multiple chat rooms, and user presence indicators. Built with JavaScript on both frontend and backend, leveraging WebSocket for low-latency bidirectional communication.
features: Responsive UI for desktop and mobile
challenges: Managing WebSocket connections at scale
Ensuring message ordering and delivery guarantees

title: Car Rental Application
shortDescription: Full-featured car rental web application for customers to browse, book, and manage vehicle rentals.
fullDescription: A full-featured car rental platform built with JavaScript, allowing customers to browse available vehicles, make bookings, and manage their rentals. Includes an admin panel for fleet management, booking confirmations, and customer records. One of Praful's starred repositories on GitHub.
features: Vehicle browsing with search and filters
Admin panel for fleet and customer management
challenges: Building availability logic to prevent double bookings
Managing large vehicle image assets efficiently

title: SEO Blog Generator API
shortDescription: Python API for generating SEO-optimized blog topics and full blog content using AI.
fullDescription: A Python-based API for generating SEO-optimized content. The system includes a topic generation service and a full blog generation service, making it easy to produce high-quality, search-engine-friendly articles at scale. Built with Python and FastAPI.
features: Full blog post generation with AI
challenges: Prompt engineering for consistent SEO-quality output
Rate limiting and API cost management

title: Feedback Collection App
shortDescription: TypeScript-based full-stack feedback collection application for gathering and managing user responses.
fullDescription: A full-stack feedback collection application built with TypeScript. Allows organisations to create feedback forms, collect responses from users, and review aggregated results. Clean UI with form validation and a backend API for persistent storage.
challenges: Building a flexible form schema that supports multiple question types
Ensuring data integrity in response submissions

title: Chatbot UI
shortDescription: A clean, responsive chatbot interface built with HTML and CSS — ready to integrate with any backend AI service.
fullDescription: A polished chatbot UI built with HTML and CSS, designed to be easily integrated with any backend AI or NLP service. Features a smooth chat bubble interface, typing indicators, and a mobile-friendly layout. Useful as a starter template for AI assistants or customer support bots.
features: Easy to integrate with any AI backend
challenges: Creating smooth CSS animations for a natural chat feel
Ensuring accessibility compliance in the chat interface

title: CRM API
shortDescription: A RESTful CRM (Customer Relationship Management) API built with Node.js and Express for managing contacts and interactions.
fullDescription: A RESTful API for a Customer Relationship Management system, built with JavaScript, Node.js, and Express. Supports full CRUD operations for contacts, companies, and interaction records. Designed to be a backend foundation for CRM frontends or integrations.
features: Full CRUD for contacts, companies, and interactions
RESTful API design with proper HTTP methods
challenges: Designing a flexible data model for different CRM use cases
Implementing clean separation between routes, controllers, and models

title: Daily Publish Automation
shortDescription: Python automation script for scheduled daily content publishing workflows.
fullDescription: A Python automation tool designed to streamline daily content publishing workflows. Handles scheduling, content processing, and automated publishing to target platforms. Built with Python and leverages cron-style scheduling for reliable execution.
challenges: Ensuring reliable scheduling without missing publish windows
Handling API rate limits from publishing platforms
